name: Library of Congress
description: Public domain in the United States only: films published more than 95 years ago and sound recordings published more than 100 years ago, from the Library of Congress's online collections (Edison's films and records, the Spanish-American War, early animation, the Westinghouse Works, early San Francisco and New York, the National Screening Room); items whose rights statement names a restriction are left out.
author: Raygun
